## Checks
- [ ] `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `mypy --strict`
- [ ] `pytest -m "not device"`

- [ ] Docs/SPEC updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal screen content in the diff
